title: Plan production quality and product release
summary: Before manufacturing or releasing a physical-product batch or material design change. A traceable accepted batch or documented hold with quality evidence and release authority.
outcomes: A traceable accepted batch or documented hold with quality evidence and release authority.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before manufacturing or releasing a physical-product batch or material design change.

parts.title: Define the product configuration and acceptance criteria
parts.guidance: Record the approved design, bill of materials, intended use, tolerances and test requirements. Identify product-market requirements with qualified specialists and keep unresolved safety questions outside release authority.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the production and quality plan
parts.guidance: Engineering, quality and operations owners agree supplier controls, process checks, sampling, traceability and nonconformance handling. Confirm responsibility for tooling, changes and outsourced tests.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve the production and quality plan

parts.title: Run the controlled production and inspections
parts.guidance: Qualified operators execute the approved process and record material lots, measurements and deviations. Segregate unaccepted output and preserve traceability instead of changing acceptance criteria after seeing results.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Run the controlled production and inspections

parts.title: Review deviations and authorize release
parts.guidance: The designated quality and product authorities evaluate test evidence, corrective actions and applicable approvals. Record accepted concessions or holds and keep unsafe or unapproved product out of customer delivery.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile batch records and field feedback
parts.guidance: Retain the configuration, release evidence and distribution traceability. Monitor returns and safety reports and feed recurring problems into corrective action and product-safety response.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A traceable accepted batch or documented hold with quality evidence and release authority.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
